How do I measure?

Three rules and a tape measure. Everything in millimetres.

2. Check the depth. To fit inside you need at least 60 mm inside the sill, from the window or burglar guards to the edge. Vertical blinds need 90 mm.

3a. Inside mount. Window sizes can vary because of plastering, so measure the width and the height three times and write down the smallest. We subtract 10 mm for clearance. Example: width 1250 × height 980.

3b. Outside mount. Measure the width and drop and add at least 50 mm to each side, top and bottom. For vertical blinds add 100 mm. Example: width 1350 × drop 1080.

Measure three times. Write down the smallest.

Try it: three widths

Measuring a sliding door? The guide says an outside mount is best, going 100 mm over the sides and top, so door handles don’t get in the way.

Send my measurements

How do I get the 10% off?

Measure your own windows and send me the measurements: that earns you an extra 10% discount.

Once we receive your deposit, a representative visits to verify your measurements.

What if I get it wrong?

Ask for self-measuring insurance when you order:

  • It costs 3% of the total amount of your blinds.
  • We replace no more than 30% of the number of blinds on the order.
  • It covers a measurement that is out by no more than 60 mm per blind.

If you don’t ask for it, we are not responsible if mistakes are made.

Ask for it when you order!

What does a call-out cost?

If you’d rather I send someone to measure for you, there is a cash call-out fee, from R300, depending on the distance from Pinetown.

It’s paid in cash to the consultant, and it is refunded when you place your order.

Measuring yourself is what earns the extra 10%, so have a look at how to measure above if you’re up for it.

Ask me to measure

Can you fit them?

Yes, at your home or office, or we can deliver to your doorstep. Fitting is the call-out fee for your distance, plus a fee per blind:

1 or 2 blindsR150 each
3 or 4 blindsR130 each
5 or moreR110 each
Panel blindR200 each
Outdoor roller blindR500 each

Happy to fit it yourself to save money? Headbar-style roller blinds are the easiest to install.

Please check your blinds after they are fitted and make sure you’re happy with the job. Comebacks are charged as per call-out fees.

Ask about fitting

What’s the guarantee?

Every blind comes with a 3-year carry-in guarantee.

If you find a factory fault, take a photo and send it to me. I’ll tell you if it must be repaired at the factory, in which case you bring it to our offices (that’s the carry-in), or if we can send a technician. On-site fixes are within a 50 km radius of our offices.

All blinds get a double quality check. If you break anything while fitting, bring it in and we repair it free of charge.

One honest thing: because every blind is custom-made, we don’t accept returns.

So measure three times!
Ask about the guarantee

Can you clean my blinds?

In Durban and surrounding areas, yes: vertical, Venetian and roller blinds. Cleaning can’t be done on site, but some repairs can.

Vertical blinds are cleaned per blade: R7 each when the drop is under 1.5 m, R9 each when it’s over. Venetian prices depend on the type and width, so just ask me.
